title: Mt Eliza Farmers Market
summary: The daytime edition of the Mount Eliza farmers market ran on the Village Green and Mt Eliza Way service road. The December 2026 twilight edition is a separate event.

heroImage.alt: Conceptual market produce and ceramics beneath a striped canopy.

streetAddress: Corner Mt Eliza Way and Canadian Bay Road
recurrenceNote: Fourth Sunday October through November 2026, 9am to 1pm.
accessibilityNotes: Access details have not been confirmed with the organiser.
weatherDependency: Outdoor; organiser says the market runs rain, hail or shine.
provenance: The organiser's 2026 calendar lists 25 October and 22 November, 9am to 1pm. The December market listed by the organiser is Friday 18 December, 3pm to 8pm. This daytime record is retained for reference and may not infer new dates.
nearbyAttractions: Mount Eliza Village cafes; Mt Eliza beach
editorVerdict: A VFMA-accredited village market with local growers and specialty makers, supported by the Mt Eliza Chamber of Commerce.
editorNote: The organiser lists 25 October and 22 November 2026 as the last daytime sessions in its 2026 calendar. The December market is a separate twilight edition on Friday 18 December, from 3pm to 8pm. Use the organiser's calendar for any future dates.
